_comment: copy as config.json (or via environment variable ARTEX_CONFIG specify another path).this file only contains database and skill_dir two items; LLM remaining config comes from env vars or in-app settings, not in this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection.priority: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > this file database.choose one of the two formats: (A) fill in the separate fields below; (B) fill in only database.dsn one complete connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: format (B): delete the above database, switch to the full DSN.dsn non-empty DSN overrides split fields.
_comment_skill_dir: skill root directory (one per subdirectory skill, including SKILL.md).priority: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > Default (next to the executable skills/).leave blank or delete this field to use the default.relative paths resolve against the current working directory.
